result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The fix is in `DataStore.countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The count subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, which is the same filter the per-quarter report uses, and I updated the method's Javadoc to say so. Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='*SalesRep*'`. It finished with no failures, but I didn't check which tests it matched.
